## Key Learnings & Decisions

- `engine-cpp` (C++17) in WSL2 is the sole live execution engine; `engine/` (C) is reference-only.
- Event pipeline must emit directly as POSIX syscalls return, rather than reconstructing logs from completed traces.
- All exit pathways must emit `CLEANUP` and guarantee zero leaked child processes or zombies.
- Web UI design is frozen; integration will stream live NDJSON events into existing panels.
